headline: A U.S. diplomat told the UN Security Council that Sudan’s war is spilling into the Sahel, warned there is no military solution, and urged both sides to accept an unconditional humanitarian truce. The conflict pits the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) under General al-Burhan, which includes Muslim Brotherhood-linked elements, against the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Washington also warned terrorist groups are exploiting the growing instability across West Africa, including Mali.

headline: Iran has struck U.S. bases in Jordan four times over five days, wounding dozens of American troops and damaging multiple Black Hawk helicopters, per the NYT. The deadliest hit came Friday at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Azraq, killing two U.S. soldiers, leaving one missing, and injuring four. The same base was struck two days earlier, wounding about 20. U.S. officials say the attacks demonstrate Iran's growing ability to overwhelm or evade American air defenses.
